target.title: add per-conversation whatsapp debounce config
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The existing WhatsApp debounce setting is too broad for mixed usage.

Some conversations should be processed immediately, while others should wait briefly so OpenClaw can batch several short messages into one agent turn. This matters for owner chats, external direct chats, and busy groups that need different timing.

AI-assisted: yes, Codex helped update this branch and evidence.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds per-conversation inbound debounce settings for WhatsApp direct chats and groups while keeping the existing channel-level debounce as the fallback.

The runtime now supports:

- `channels.whatsapp.direct["<id>"].debounceMs`
- `channels.whatsapp.direct["*"].debounceMs`
- `channels.whatsapp.groups["<id>"].debounceMs`
- `channels.whatsapp.groups["*"].debounceMs`
- account-scoped direct/group maps that replace the matching root map for that account

## User Impact

Operators can tune WhatsApp batching per conversation without changing the global WhatsApp debounce for every chat.

Examples:

- owner/admin direct chats can use `debounceMs: 0` for immediate turns
- external direct chats can wait longer for short message bursts
- busy groups can have their own window
- wildcard entries can set direct/group defaults

## Evidence

Current head: `7cab374d3e9fa076aa9f9936cad12bd86757219f`

Redacted real WhatsApp setup proof from a local OpenClaw home was already captured for this PR. It used real WhatsApp session keys from the local OpenClaw session index, printed only counts and redacted aliases, and showed:

```text
0ms real-session-inventory direct=200 group=3
0ms config <redacted-direct-1> debounceMs=0
0ms config <redacted-direct-2> debounceMs=120
0ms config <redacted-group-1> debounceMs=180
0ms flush <redacted-direct-1> items=1 debounceMs=0
0ms flush <redacted-direct-1> items=1 debounceMs=0
151ms flush <redacted-direct-2> items=2 debounceMs=120
220ms flush <redacted-group-1> items=2 debounceMs=180
# exit code 0
```

Focused validation after rebasing on current `origin/main`:

```text
$ pnpm docs:list
# exit code 0
```

```text
$ node --import tsx scripts/generate-bundled-channel-config-metadata.ts --check
# exit code 0
```

```text
$ node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.extensions.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/extensions-test.tsbuildinfo
# exit code 0
```

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.runtime-config.config.ts src/config/zod-schema.providers-whatsapp.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       11 passed (11)
```

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.e2e.config.ts extensions/whatsapp/src/auto-reply.web-auto-reply.connection-and-logging.e2e.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       29 passed (29)
```

```text
$ git diff --check
# exit code 0
```

```text
$ codex review --base origin/main
No actionable correctness issues were found in the reviewed diff. The per-conversation WhatsApp debounce config is wired through schema/types, account-scoped runtime config, listener options, and the existing debouncer path coherently.
```
